description_en: Uninstalls a managed Prometheus agent for a serverless Kubernetes (ASK) cluster, Distributed Cloud Container Platform for Kubernetes (ACK One) cluster, or Elastic Compute Service (ECS) cluster
kebab_example: aliyun arms uninstall-managed-prometheus --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-type ask --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UninstallManagedPrometheus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster. This parameter is required when the ClusterType parameter is set to ask or one
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云容器服务Kubernetes版的Kubernetes集群的ID。ClusterType为ask或one时，必填
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Prometheus instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster type. Valid values: ask, ecs, and one
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the cluster resides
parameters.name: vpc_id

Code.description_en: The status code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful. If another status code is returned, the request failed
Code.description_zh: 状态码。200为成功，其他状态码为异常

Data.description_en: The response content. The status of the Prometheus instance is returned
Data.description_zh: 响应内容。通常返回安装状态

Message.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 失败时返回的响应描述

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the Prometheus instance was removed
